protocol.data: /Users/ozgur/.cache/ids-x17/combine.csv (CIC-IDS2017 MachineLearningCVE, 2214468 rows); Protocol imputed from port
protocol.split: feature-fingerprint groups (idsresearch.groups), label-blind, ratios pool/calibration/test=[0.5, 0.1, 0.4], seed 2017
protocol.calibration: calibration partition split by groups 50/50: probability half (temperature, <=100k rows, classes represented in the model's training data only) and alarm half (threshold at 5% benign FPR, empirical order statistic, idsresearch.decision.threshold_fit)
protocol.prior_offset: adapted models: idsresearch.decision.prior_offset(budget, budget) -> 0 for classes in the budget, masked (-1e9) for classes absent from it; budget is a proportional stratified sample so no prior shift. frozen_recal keeps the 2018 offset and temperature.
protocol.label_space: 13 CSE-CIC-IDS2018 classes + PortScan; Heartbleed unclassed (attack in binary metrics, excluded from macro-F1)
protocol.budget_sampling: proportional class-stratified sample of the pool, >=1 row per class present in the pool, seed-dependent
protocol.esnn_t4_finetune: from app/models/esnn_t4.pt, all layers, extra PortScan output (zero-initialised), AdamW lr=0.0001, wd=1e-3, batch=256, max(5 epochs, 300 steps), unweighted CE, no early stopping or selection
protocol.xgb_scratch: XGBClassifier 400 trees, depth 8, lr 0.1, subsample/colsample 0.8 (2018 settings), on 2018-preprocessed features
protocol.xgb_continue: 2018 booster + 100 rounds on the budget (PortScan rows dropped: 13-class model)
protocol.macro_f1: over classes present in the test partition (14-class space incl. PortScan); prediction = argmax attack class if alarm else Benign
protocol.no_test_use: no choice (epochs, lr, rounds, thresholds) uses test rows
